landing.heroDescription: Language courses and integration guides - so you can speak German and know how to use it in everyday life in Germany.
landing.whyTitle: Language and life in Germany - in one place
landing.whyDescription: Büro.de combines German language courses with integration courses. You learn the language and also where and how to use it - from everyday situations to bureaucracy.
landing.benefitStartDesc: Open the first module at no cost and see how the courses work.
landing.benefitLifetimeDesc: Buy once and keep access - no renewal, no end date.
landing.benefitStructuredDesc: Lessons follow a clear path, so each step builds on the last.
landing.benefitRealLifeDesc: Alongside language courses, integration courses cover how life in Germany actually works - and how to apply your German there.
landing.benefitShortDesc: Learn German in 2–10 minutes. Short, focused video lessons make learning easier to fit into your day - without long, overwhelming lectures.
landing.progressPreviewAria: Preview of course progress in the platform
landing.loopSubtitle: A complete learning loop - watch a short lesson, practise, review vocabulary, test yourself and track what you have mastered.
landing.loopWatchDesc: Focused video lessons you can finish in one sitting.
landing.loopTrackDesc: See your progress at a glance.
landing.painTitle: You know the words. You still freeze when it matters.
landing.painHint: Choose the situation that feels most like yours
landing.painItem1Title: You need to answer - and go silent
landing.painItem1Body: At the Amt, the doctor or work you need to say something simple. You know the words - but in the moment they are gone.
landing.painItem2Title: You know the rule. Not the sentence.
landing.painItem2Body: You know the table and you do the exercises. Putting your own sentence together in conversation still feels like seeing German for the first time.
landing.painItem3Title: You learn everywhere. There is no path.
landing.painItem3Body: YouTube, an app, a table, another channel. Plenty of material - and no clear path to a result.
landing.painClosing: Do you recognize yourself? Now we’ll show how Büro.de turns these difficulties into a clear learning path.

landing.quizBody: Know it. Don't just watch it. Quizzes help you reinforce what you've learned before you move on.

landing.whatYouGetOneOnOne: You can also book a 1-on-1 session if you need a live explanation
landing.faqSubtitle: A new platform - here is what we can tell you today.
landing.faqQ1: Is the first module really free?
landing.faqA1: Yes. You can open the first module at no cost and see how we teach before you buy a course.
landing.faqQ2: How long do I have access to the course?
landing.faqA2: Lifetime. One purchase, no expiration date. Come back whenever you want.
landing.faqQ3: Do I need to follow a schedule?
landing.faqA3: No. Learn when it suits you. There is no timetable, and access does not expire after purchase.
landing.faqQ4: What kinds of courses do you offer?
landing.faqA4: Language courses (A1–B2) and integration courses about life in Germany - so you learn the language and how to use it day to day.
landing.faqQ5: Can I learn on my phone?
landing.faqA5: Yes. Büro.de works in the browser on your phone, tablet, and computer. You do not need to install an app.
landing.faqQ6: What happens after I purchase a course?
landing.faqA6: The course appears in My Learning. You can open any lesson, track what you have completed, and continue from where you left off.
landing.faqA7: Refund terms will be published here. If you have a question about a purchase, please contact us.
landing.faqQ8: What if something is still unclear?
landing.faqA8: You can leave your contact details and book a 1-on-1 session with a teacher - for personal explanations when self-study is not enough.
landing.propositionTitle: Learn the language of everyday life
landing.propositionDescription: Our courses don't stop at grammar and vocabulary. We teach you how to order at a Kneipe, what to say at the Bürgeramt, how German humor works, and why you should never be late.
landing.propositionItem4: Understanding the Pfand system and recycling culture
